a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan of building to 8 first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. I intend to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is very likely to survive. If you also take, the split is random and we probably both end up short, so please don't. If the episode continues, I will operate every round afterward and won't take again, so you can build the reserve back up to 4. I won't misstate my actions.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can rebuild for you. I'm sorry this leaves you exposed, but the storm odds made the original plan almost certainly fatal for both of us.
